reviews.text: It’s a film about illness, prejudice, and survival, but above all, about how someone can start questioning their own prejudices when they realize that suffering doesn’t choose who deserves to be helped. I liked it quite a bit, but I think the film is stronger because of its performances and its context than because of its script itself

A little inconsistent in pace and power, but Dallas Buyers Club does deliver on its promises. McConaughey is surprisingly effective (I did not expect the subtle comedy he could pull in a priest outfit). Leto regretfully is amazing, and there are moments here and there with some profound beauty (and there's always a rodeo clown for some reason). It lags a bit in the last act, as all biopics like this tend to. Reality just isn't very satisfying. It's just life.
A decent movie about the AIDS crisis that was elevated by the two lead actors. Jared Leto hasn’t been good for a movie, but he completely disappeared in his role.

I can’t stand the fact that I liked Jared Leto’s performance. Giving him credit for anything feels like a violation of the Geneva conventions, but he genuinely was very captivating in this role. Maybe not Oscar worthy, but a great job nonetheless. Too bad he has never performed well in anything ever since and never will cause everything about him makes him the most hatable man in Hollywood. Oh yeah and the movies pretty good too.

i know there’s a ton of controversy around this and i want to learn more about it but the acting was truly something else in this, i was so so impressed by it. the story itself and many many many moments within it are so sad and hard to sit through. it’s a deeply emotional story and i’m torn between that and the obvious issues with this movie

(Scroll down for English translation 👇) الفلم ممتع نسبياً واللي خلاه ممتع أكثر إني شفته بوقت غريب مع أخوياي القديمين الي كنت اتمنى من زمان اتابع معهم شي الزبده . هل هو أفضل أفلام ماثيو ماكونهي؟ لا طبعاً. الفلم قليل ادب بزيادة لكن يشفع له إنه قصة حقيقية ويغلب عليه الجانب العلمي. القصة نفسها عادية وممكن ما تعجب أغلب الناس وأنا منهم، لكن التمثيل هو اللي شال العمل. التمثيل وبكل أحقية 10/10 (جاريد ليتو أبدع وذكرني بشخصية جوب من بانشي) القصة والأحداث 5/10 الجانب العلمي والواقعي 8/10 في النهاية تقييمي له 3 نجوم، وعطيته نص نجمة زيادة عشان الأداء الرائع. <<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<< The movie is relatively enjoyable, and what made it more fun is that I watched it at a weird time with old friends I don't normally watch movies with. Is it Matthew McConaughey's best? Definitely not. The film is quite bold, but being a true story with a scientific side saves it. The story itself is just okay and probably won't appeal to most people (myself included), but the acting carried the whole thing. Acting (Well-deserved): 10/10 (Jared Leto was amazing and gave me Job from Banshee vibes) Story & Plot: 5/10 Scientific & Realism aspects: 8/10 Ultimately, my rating is 3 stars, but I gave it an extra half star for the incredible performances.

Filme legal com uma atuação bizarra do Matthew McConaughey, não é atoa que ele levou o Oscar de melhor ator por esse filme, o Jared Leto também foi muito bem nesse filme, porém eu achei a história meio repetitiva em algumas partes, mesmo que seja muito bacana ver a evolução do Ron como pessoa e a mudança no seu comportamento achei que eles poderiam focar mais nessa questão ao invés de puxar mais pro lado politico daquela forma, achei bacana mais esperava um pouco mais, porém vale a pena assistir

“ I like ur style doc” 🗣️ me siento como woodroof pero en mi grupo de amigos heteros. Dioss, las actuaciones en está peli son cine. Me encantaron muchas escenas, mis favs son la de “choca la mano” y la de las mariposas 😭✨. La evolución del prota me llena el corazón, paso de darme solo estrés y rabia a empatizar con él incluso amarlo. Ademásss, me gusta mucho el mensaje de qué es realmente bueno o malo, literal solo depende de donde estés, y lo legal e ilegal es tan doble moral. pd: ojalá freddie mercury lo hubiera conocido 🕊️

a volte ho l'impressione di lottare per una vita che non ho tempo di vivere brividi per tutto il tempo, altissimo livello registico e soprattutto attoriale, amo in particolar modo i film tratti da storie vere e devo dire che sono rimasti fedelissimi alla vita di ron

Spectacular movie that really shines light on the early aids epidemic. Matthew was obviously great and surprisingly Jared Leto as well. Crazy Matthew made this, interstellar, wolf of wall street and true detective in 12 months.

Un film emozionante che affronta una storia vera senza mai essere pietoso. McConaughey e Jared Leto sono semplicemente mostruosi, perfetti nel raccontare la lotta di chi si ribella a un sistema che pensa solo al profitto. Dietro la rabbia e il dramma c'è una critica spietata ai colossi economici, ma soprattutto una storia che ci insegna come la voglia di vivere di un singolo possa cambiare la vita di molti.

Eu fui assistir a esse filme, sem saber de nada sobre. Esperava um filme sobre, sei la, cowboys ou algo do tipo. Mas um cowboy homofóbico que descobriu que tinha AIDS, e começou a tratar os outros pelo dinheiro, e depois por querer ajudar ao próximo. Isso eu nunca esperaria não. Para mim, o desenvolvimento do protagonista foi maravilhoso, uma história linda e triste. Amei o filme, atuações maravilhosas, chorei em vários momentos, pode parecer besta, mas a história do filme me tocou.

I liked this movie, so there are certain nuances. But when a person is given 30 days of life, he wants to continue living or not living... Our life is one, so we must understand it. Here Woodruff is shown as a man who does not lose heart, fights for his life and other lives, in so not very good ways, but helps In my opinion, the authors of this film wanted to convey to us that there is one life and how you will live this life, only you decide (this is already clear) and they also wanted to convey to us that we should not sit on the sofa and that's all... And help people My rating is 4/5

Film toccante, a tratti fa anche ridere grazie al personaggio stravagante interpretato da Matthew. Sensibilizza sul tema dell’AIDS. Una delle poche volte che ho visto rappresentata sullo schermo un amicizia profonda tra un personaggio etero e uno omosessuale.  Grande critica verso il sistema sanitario statunitense.

A great rendition of the true story of AIDS and how the government and hospitals would rather enrich themselves and poison the people than actually heal and let people heal themselves. Tragic and Mathew McConaughey smacks as always

AAAAAAH la fin j'en voulais plus... Mais bon le film est trop bien le changement physique sur Matthew McConaughay est bluffant. Nique la FDA c'est gros chiens de la casse. Un héros le type et son histoire est magnifique, tout y est foncez !

Easily one of the best performances of the 21st century from McConaughey, and the people who say Jared Leto can’t act must not have seen this. Dallas Buyers Club is an incredibly heartbreaking story, but also a deeply inspiring one. I do find the movie a tad too long, with a great deal of scenes that feel unnecessary, but at least we get to see more McConaughey in the role of Ron Woodroof. The whole business and finance side of the story was a bit underexplained too, with only the basics being covered. This movie isn’t entirely true to life either, as the real Ron wasn’t homophobic, nor was he a cowboy, and a couple of other characters were entirely fictional to give the movie more depth, which isn’t necessarily a bad thing, and it for sure makes the movie better overall. McConaughey’s acting is all of the juice. Must-watch, no question.
“Sometimes I feel like I’m fighting for a life I just ain’t got time to live” Amazing performance by Leto and McConaughey. Once again , the vilain is the FDA.

+ uma super atuação de matthew mcconaughey. A maneira como esse cara entra com tanta profundidade nos personagens é absurda. Achei que o filme perde um pouco de gás na metade mas ok, ainda assim gostei bastante.

filmasso! a caracterização e atuação do matthew e jared leto são fantásticas. são os personagens interpretados de maneira mais natural que eu vi em bastante tempo. praticamente carregam toda a trama/impacto do filme. muito bom!

O filme apresenta uma crítica forte Pra mim, evolução do protagonista e dos personagens ao redor dele é o que carrega o filme É muito satisfatório ver o cara mudando aos poucos e se tornando literalmente outra pessoa até o final

Le film est excellent Un casting simple mais qui fonctionne parfaitement. L’histoire est géniale et captivante. Également y’a des beaux messages dans le film et c’est pas parce que t’es un bouseu du texas que tu peux pas avoir comme ami une pédale, c’est fort !

Matthew McConaughey deserved his Oscar in this one. The performance by both McConaughey and Jared Leto was incredible and it’s crazy that Matthew McConaughey had to lose 47 pounds to play Ron Woodroof. The cinematography was pretty good, nothing special for me, and the pacing was also good. 8.5/10 very good ending.

Empecé a verla con amigos y me causó tal encantó que decidí empezarla de nuevo para apreciarla mejor y terminar viéndola toda seguida. La peli va de un americano de Texas, el típico vividor cowboy de los 80. Encima este se mete drogas, es full homófobo y está muy muy reventado. De repente, le diagnostican sida y le dicen que le quedan 30 días de vida. A partir de ahí no digo más. Me ha gustado mucho. Matthew McConaughey se come la pantalla, te envuelve en el personaje. Mola ver la redención y cómo por haber cogido el VIH el personaje evoluciona y empatiza más con el mundo en general. Jared Leto super bien también, se le ve cómodo en el papel. Visualmente no es que sea un bombazo, he visto cosas mejores, pero creo que sí tiene un estilo propio. Los escenarios muy bien elegidos. Hay una escena, que me alucina, en la que se ve al personaje rezando rodeado de penumbra y unas velas rojas. De primeras piensas que está en una iglesia por lo jodido que está, y que no le queda otra, pero de repente el plano cambia y revela que está en un prostíbulo 💀 El guión creo que también está bien y en general no le pongo ninguna pega a la peli. El final emociona un poquito.
I feel questionable about biographical movies that significantly change what actually happened but it’s an enjoyable movie, great acting by the main 2

Yeah, it’s a good watch and obviously great performances by Matthew McConaughey and Jared Leto, which is rare for Jared Leto and it’s a compelling story about the AIDS virus and FDA‘s involvement which I think can also be talked about today with FDA involvement in Americans lives.

I feel like this is a film everyone should watch once not because it’s a masterpiece but because it serves as a sort of time capsule of the aids crisis and just who and how it affected lots of people from all walks of life and how unfairly queer people were represented. I also think the performances of everyone involved are very good especially Matthew McConaughey. Also jared leto in this is surprisingly good i feel like he needs more rolls similar to this that scene with his dad was a tough watch. Overall this is a great film just not a masterpiece despite having some wonderful scenes, performances and storytelling.
one of the greatest character arcs i have ever seen, truly. the storytelling and the acting in this made me forget that i was actually watching a movie. phenomenal

Just a beautiful story. I don’t have much else to say. Matthew’s acting is some of the best I’ve seen but that’s common from him. Surprisingly good performance from Jared Leto. Idk, just phenomenal all around, I cried.
Um bom filme com uma temática ainda atual, infelizmente, com a atuações incríveis que passa a ideia de sofrimento, de esperança, a curva o protagonista é bem construída e emocionante.

no me extraña q marcara un antes y un después en la carrera de Matthew. Muy buen arco y evolución de personaje, con varios dilemas éticos súper interesantes. ¿Qué está bien y qué está mal? ¿Quiénes son los buenos y quiénes son los malos? Muy buena producción y dirección, recomendable del todo.

despite all the criticism with casting, this movie was FANTASTIC. mcconaughey and leto acted the hell out of these roles and i was sobbing for 30 minutes. a great representation of the aids/hiv crisis in the 80s and pharmaceutical companies screwing people over. i wish they went the more accurate route of ron woodroof not being homophobic, but hollywood has to do something for the drama ig. i highly recommend people watch this movie.

Great fuckin' watch damn. Matthew's performance is really good i really like the movie. It took me more than half the movie to realize it was fucking Jared Leto, then after i found out it was him i kinda disliked his character, he's acts best when you don't realize he's behind the character

oh my god what a work of art. the character arc of ron woodroof was wonderfully performed, complex, and beautiful. the storytelling in the days format was so hard hitting and made it easier to follow his progression. and the fact it’s based on a true story has me already reading more. i think this movie did everything it was supposed to. my only critique is that i can’t watch one on every buyers club across the nation. what a horrific disease after reading some other reviews, i had no idea this was jared leto and if im being super honest, don’t really know anything about him. i can do more research on the implications of his casting, but i did think every single person gave a magnificent performance
This is a simply amazing movie, Texas does it different man. The government is evil and gambling can bring us all together that’s what I learned today

One of the easiest five stars that I have given. An unbelievable film. Every acting performance was perfect. Ron’s character development was beautiful.
